text: Ahriman is a senior Thousand Sons officer and an accomplished practitioner of the Legion’s psychic disciplines. His loyalty to Magnus is joined to a conviction that knowledge can bring understanding and control.
The judgement at Nikaea rejects the practices on which his Legion relies. The subsequent confrontation at Prospero forces Ahriman into a desperate defence of Tizca and his brothers.
He survives the destruction of Prospero and is carried away with the remnant of the Legion. The costs of their pursuit of mastery can no longer be separated from their future.
